integrity_statement: Proof and attached finite exhaustive verification are presented as scientific arguments and reproducible checks, not as independent external certification. The earlier ambient relation normal form and standard Bell/Stirling theory are attributed.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies to a fixed finite linearly ordered intuitionistic carrier, not arbitrary finite partial orders.
Counts are of raw strong prefix-closed dense relations; their induced nuclei are fewer and counted separately.
Independent audit of proof and originality has not been performed; the inaccessible original Goldblatt article and unindexed mathematical literature leave residual prior-coverage risk.
title: Bell–Stirling partition classification of dense strong Kripke chains
